claims.subject: proof_of_address
claims.statement: Hotline staff told remote applicants they could not apply without a utility bill or lease in their own name.
claims.scope: remote community applicants, as told by hotline staff
claims.quote: Each of them said they were told they could not apply because they did not have a utility bill or lease in their own name.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The declared remote community applications procedure already covers households from remote communities who lack a utility bill or lease.
claims.quote: Our declared remote community applications procedure already covers these households, but it sits in the regional records system, which hotline staff cannot see.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The department's AI assistant goes live on 1 July.
claims.quote: Could we meet this week to work out how to get the procedure in front of hotline staff before the department's AI assistant goes live on 1 July?
